summary: Iteration 2 (Zerodha + Profile + Strategy Runner) tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 new pytest tests pass (profile defaults, profile update + validation, change-password guards, /zerodha/login-url + status + exchange + disconnect, watchlist mock fallback, paper-order placement, live-order rejected when not connected, max_position_size enforcement, holdings empty without Zerodha). Iteration 1 suite still green. Strategy runner confirmed to start in supervisor logs ('Strategy runner starting (tick=30s)'). Frontend: /profile route renders all 7 testid sections, mode-badge in top bar shows PAPER, toggle-mode-btn calls PUT /api/profile (200 OK), /broker-keys page renders Step1/2/3, copy-redirect works, Connect-without-keys triggers 400 with correct toast 'Save your Zerodha api_key + api_secret on Broker Keys first', Connect after saving bogus keys returns valid kite.zerodha.com URL and browser redirects (Kite then rejects bogus key as expected). nav-profile link works.

minor.issue: When `broker_keys` row exists but has no api_key (very unlikely path), kite_helper would raise unhandled. Currently guarded by 'Save Zerodha keys first' only when row missing. Defensive only.

Iteration-1 finding still open: no Pydantic validator on qty (accepts 0 or negative). Risk-guard catches absurd values via max_position_size but a qty=0 BUY would pass and insert a stub position with qty=0.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning 'width(-1)/height(-1) - container has no size' on initial render — iteration-1 finding still open.

action_items: Optional: add Pydantic `gt=0` validator on OrderReq.qty to reject 0/negative.
Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent sizing (iteration-1 carryover).
Optional: clean up dead history-replay loop in /api/ai/chat (iteration-1 carryover).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~960 lines — getting close to the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting auth/profile/zerodha/orders/strategies into separate routers.
_safe_run_python in server.py and _safe_run in strategy_runner.py are near-duplicates. Extract to a shared sandbox module (DRY).

Strategy runner exec()s user Python code on every tick with NO time/memory cap. A malicious or buggy strategy can hang the runner event loop and block every other live strategy. Wrap in `asyncio.to_thread` + timeout, or run in a subprocess.
JWT_SECRET default fallback is 'dev-secret' if env missing — fail fast instead.
/api/profile PUT does not validate numeric ranges (e.g. max_position_size could be set to negative).
ProfileUpdateReq accepts paper_mode flip without re-auth or 2FA — for a 'real money' switch this is risky. Consider requiring password confirmation when going LIVE.
